author: Camemes
body:
Just a suggestion but here goes.

Similar to the scrimmage server, which I haven't used much, people can rent and/or hire building servers for their map making so they can a) build a map with friends without the need to actually make a server, and
b) Avicus Benefits to as it could possibly be a fee of like $10-$20 a month etc.

Again, this is just a thought but it would be cool if it was made a lot easier to work with friends without using a LAN world or the complicated task of making a server. Expand if you have any suggestions to add to the thought.
